messages:
Lina: Heads-up — Kestrel cohort needs 3 follow-up office hours next week to finish the dedicated migration onboarding. Two accounts showed low NPS and are flagged for renewal risk. Can we schedule sessions + a feedback capture?

Ravi: I can host Mon/Tue mornings PST.

Tom: Afternoons work better for me. For APAC coverage we probably need one early-morning PST slot or run two sessions.

Priya: I can do a 45m deep-dive on quantization & perf tuning (Wed). Happy to demo the small config changes that cut cost ~20%.

Eleni (CSM): For the at-risk accounts (Kestrel A + B) let's do a private 1:1 + a public office hour. I’ll prep renewal notes and a short status deck. Also agree we need a feedback touchpoint after each session.

Lina: OK — proposal:
- Public office hours: Wed 08:00 PST (works for CET afternoons) & Thu 16:00 JST (APAC-friendly)
- Private 1:1s: schedule for risk accounts between sessions
- Feedback: 3-question form (confidence, blockers, next step) + NPS checkbox

Priya: Draft agenda for the public office hour:
```
00–05m: Quick status + rollouts update (Eleni)
05–20m: Migration checklist & common errors (Ravi)
20–45m: Quantization/perf demo (Priya)
45–60m: Q&A + next steps + feedback link (Lina)
```

Ravi: I’ll create the invites and include runbooks. For the private 1:1s I’ll block 30m slots Thu/ Fri morning PST. @Tom can you spare 30m pre-call to run the walkthrough?

Tom: Yep, I can do a 30m dry-run. Ping me the calendar event once created. :thumbsup:

calendar-bot: Event created — "Kestrel Cohort — Office Hour (public)" Wed 08:00 PST. Invite: cohort+kestrel-csms@example.com.

Lina: I’ll build the Google form and post the short link in the invite + slack thread. Also attaching the one-page checklist in the event.

Eleni (CSM): Will capture renewal signals in the account notes after each 1:1 (scorecard + recommended PS). I’ll also send a brief pre-read to the customers so sessions are focused.

Ravi: Quick ops note — add a recording consent line in the invite and mark the session as "recorded for internal enablement" for legal.

Priya: added a short pre-check script to the calendar invite: `curl -sS https://run.healthcheck.example/kestrel` — helps customers validate network & model pull before the call.

Lina: Sweet. Action items: Ravi creates invites + 1:1s; Priya preps demo + pre-check script; Tom does dry-run; Lina builds feedback form; Eleni pre-reads + renewal notes. We’ll reconvene in-thread if any blockers.

Eleni (CSM): Thanks all — I’ll follow up with the risk account owners and post outcomes after each session.

Tom: Thanks — will be ready for the rehearsal.

Ravi: Done, invites sent (check spam if you don't see them).

Lina: Great, thanks team :rocket:
